POINTS TO AGREE ON

Clarify every requirement
before proceeding

These points are discussed for each transaction, based on the product and intended market.

01

Products & quality

Product name, processing, size, appearance criteria, storage requirements and acceptance criteria.

02

Packaging & documentation

Carton specifications, weight, labeling information, origin and any documents required by the partner.

03

Delivery & commercial terms

Quantity, pricing, cost coverage, delivery schedule, destination, payment method and each party's responsibilities.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Before we work together

Can I inquire about custom specifications?

You can share processing requirements, sizes, pack weights and labeling needs. MAI KỲ HÀ SEAFOOD will discuss availability for each product and shipment.

How can I request pricing and delivery information?

Send the product name, specifications, quantity, destination and required delivery date. Pricing and timing are discussed after your requirements have been clarified.

What should we discuss about documentation and quality?

Specify the intended market, quality criteria and documents required by the buyer. Origin, storage and documentation should be confirmed for the shipment before agreeing on the transaction.
